title: Contract Tenure and the Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Good-Faith Percentage
content:
**Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract — tenure on the books and the good-faith percentage.**

**Rule.** The months on the books are the whole calendar months from the contract's first payment date to today. When the months on the books are at least 18, 5 percentage points are taken off the good-faith percentage; when they are at least 12 but fewer than 18, 2.5 points are taken off; in every other case no points are taken off.

**Counting.** Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are the difference in month numbers, less one when the later date's day number is smaller than the earlier date's, with no month-end adjustment. A first payment date still in the future gives no whole months on the books.

| Months on the books | Points taken off the good-faith percentage |
|---|---|
| 18 or more | 5 |
| 12 to 17 | 2.5 |
| fewer than 12 | 0 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- First payment date the 15th of a month; today the 15th of the month 18 months later: 18 whole months, 5 points. Today the 14th of that month: 17 whole months, 2.5 points.
- First payment date the 31st of a month; today the 30th of the month 12 months later: the day number 30 is smaller than 31, so 11 whole months and no points.
